title: Seattle Times and Newsday sue OpenAI and Microsoft for infringement
raw_excerpt: The OpenAI logo is displayed on a smartphone screen placed on a reflective surface on which the company's logo is projected in Creteil, France, on September 4, 2026, as OpenAI began rolling out GPT-6 Astra, its most advanced model to date. (Photo by Samuel Boivin/NurPhoto via Getty Images) | NurPhoto via Getty Images The Seattle Times and Newsday are just the latest plaintiffs to take OpenAI to court, alleging copyright infringement . The two outlets say the company used their journalism as training data for its AI models without permission and often reproduces passages from their reporting in response to user queries. This is similar to lawsuits filed by The New York Times , Ziff Davis , Merriam-Webster, and Encyclopedia Britannica against OpenAI. The Seattle Times and Newsday also named Microsoft as a defendant in the suit, since Copilot is built on OpenAI's technology. The publishers join a list of nearly 400 local newspapers that recently sued the two  … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: 《西雅图时报》和《新闻日报》联合起诉OpenAI和微软，指控其未经许可使用新闻内容训练AI模型，并频繁复制报道原文。这是媒体版权诉讼的最新案例，凸显AI训练数据版权争议的持续升级，对行业内容使用规则有重要影响。

title: Research acceleration: The view inside OpenAI
raw_excerpt: Inside OpenAI, coding agents are reshaping AI research. Explore early data on agent usage, experiment velocity, task complexity, and research acceleration.
summary: OpenAI发布内部研究加速报告，披露编码智能体在科研中的使用数据，包括实验速度、任务复杂度等。报告显示AI智能体已深度参与内部研究，并推动研究加速，为理解AI对科研范式的影响提供了第一手数据。

title: How we monitor internal coding agents for misalignment
summary: OpenAI公开其监控内部编码智能体以防止对齐失败的方法。文章介绍了监控机制、风险识别流程，以及如何确保智能体行为符合人类意图。这对AI安全领域具有参考价值，也回应了外界对内部AI使用的担忧。

title: LLaDA-Image: Building Strong Image Generators with Fully Open Training Recipes
summary: 论文提出LLaDA-Image，一种完全开源训练流程的图像生成模型。它强调训练细节的透明性，旨在促进可复现研究。该工作有望降低图像生成模型的复现门槛，推动社区发展。

title: Compile by Training: Turning Natural-Language Specifications into Local Neural Functions
summary: 论文提出“通过训练编译”方法，将自然语言规范转化为本地神经函数。该方法让模型直接学习执行规范，而非依赖外部编译器，有望提升AI在特定任务上的可靠性和效率。

title: Terminal-Universe: Turning Agent Trajectories into Scalable Terminal Environments
summary: 论文提出Terminal-Universe，将智能体轨迹转化为可扩展的终端环境，用于训练和评估AI智能体。该方法可生成大量真实终端交互数据，有助于提升智能体在命令行任务中的表现。

title: Random Attention: Rethinking KV Cache Eviction for Efficient Reasoning
summary: 论文提出“随机注意力”机制，重新思考KV缓存淘汰策略，以提升推理效率。通过随机选择注意力头，在保持性能的同时大幅减少缓存占用，为长上下文推理提供了新思路。

title: 具身ICL来了创业玩家！上下文成Scaling新赛道
raw_excerpt: 让机器人学会利用更长的多模态Context
summary: 具身智能领域出现新创业玩家，聚焦“具身ICL”（上下文学习），让机器人利用更长的多模态上下文进行决策。这标志着上下文学习成为具身智能的新赛道，有望推动机器人泛化能力提升。

title: blader/humanizer
raw_excerpt: Agent skill that removes signs of AI-generated writing from text
summary: GitHub热门项目“humanizer”提供Agent技能，用于去除文本中的AI生成痕迹，使内容更自然。该项目在一天内获得748星，反映了市场对AI文本人性化处理的需求。
